250-779-1479-5414-8337.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-8337.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5414-8337.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

Repeat.

728-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

3912-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

728-866-5220--66.description:

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.

Repeat.

3899-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4518-7399.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

Gain life.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2866-3200-4986-5256.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.

Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Palinchron
When Shipwreck Dowser and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-4125.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

1879-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life

Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.

Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sarkhan.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.

Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.

511-817-3129-3334-4050.description:

Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.

Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.

2921-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2921-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

575-622-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken creature, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl by paying {1}{G}, causing the creature to become a 1/1 Elemental that is still a land until end of turn.
Repeat.

1612-2607.description:
Cast Shard of the Nightbringer by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Shard of the Nightbringer triggers, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent targeted in step 2 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

706-2492.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant card
706-2492.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional instant card in hand.
706-2492.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}, causing you to copy any instant and/or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast any other instant card from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Bonus Round triggers, copying the instant.
Holding priority, cast Spelljack by paying {3}{U}{U}{U}, targeting the instant.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Spelljack that is targeting the original Spelljack.
Resolve the copy of Spelljack, countering the original Spelljack and exiling it with the ability to cast it for free from exile.
Cast Spelljack from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the instant cast in step 1.
Repeat from step 5.

The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1128-2060.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
1128-2060.description:

Activate Crystalline Crawler by paying {2}{U}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

364-1987-3227-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
364-1987-3227-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
